title: Critical Data Breach Risk
description: The risk of unauthorized access to or exfiltration of sensitive customer and financial data through external cyberattack or internal compromise, resulting in regulatory sanctions, financial loss, and reputational damage.

riskProbability.rationale: Based on threat intelligence showing increased targeting of our industry, balanced against our enhanced security controls

nonFinancialImpacts.description: Severe damage to brand trust and customer confidence
Substantial fines under data protection regulations

riskImpact.rationale: Based on analysis of recent industry breaches and our specific data exposure

riskSeverity.calculationMethod: 5x5 risk matrix combining probability and impact values

riskTolerance.rationale: Given regulatory requirements and potential reputational impact

mitigationStrategy.description: Comprehensive cybersecurity program including advanced threat protection, security monitoring, encryption, access controls, and security awareness training
mitigationStrategy.expectedOutcome: Reduce likelihood of successful breach while maintaining detection capabilities

residualRisk.description: Remaining risk primarily related to zero-day vulnerabilities and sophisticated threat actors

regulatoryImplications.implications: Breach notification requirements and potential fines up to 4% of global revenue
Requirements for securing payment card data

emergingFactors.potentialImpact: Could increase probability of successful breach
emergingFactors.monitoringApproach: Threat intelligence subscription and quarterly assessment

emergingFactors.description: Increasing integration with third-party systems expanding attack surface
